function: Soft actor-critic RL learns power allocation at the LEO satellite (optical) and at HAPs (RF, NOMA) to maximize sum-rate under rate and power constraints (p. 10).
system: LEO to N=2 HAPs on FSO (1550 nm), HAPs to Kn=4 ground devices on RF with NOMA, scalar Rayleigh gains; no RIS; antennas not specified (p. 4, p. 5, p. 12).
method: Soft actor-critic RL with policy, two Q and value DNNs (ReLU), trained online with replay buffer and sum-rate reward with penalties (p. 10, p. 11).
data_channel: Simulated: FSO channel with path loss, log-normal turbulence and pointing error; Rayleigh RF channels; 200,000 training and 20,000 testing samples (p. 5, p. 12).
test_conditions: Training 200,000 samples, testing 20,000 independently generated samples (p. 11, p. 12); sweeps over power budgets, Rmin, number of HAPs and users; no unseen-scenario test stated (p. 12-15).
baselines: Non-learned: proposed KKT/Lagrangian-dual scheme with SCA. Learned: double deep Q-learning (DQL) with 30 discrete actions per power variable [52], [53] (p. 12).
metrics: Sum-rate, outage probability, per-user rate, total consumed power at the LEO, convergence iterations (p. 12, p. 14, p. 15).
complexity: Runtime 1942.48 ms (KKT) vs 2.01 ms (SAC); SAC big-O O[I((2KnN+3N+Kn+3)W+WX+2X(KnN+2N))] vs KKT O[IKnN(2KnN+7N+1)^2] (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 5: "are modeled as Rayleigh distribution" for the RF links; FSO links p. 5: "modeled as a log-normal distribution according to [35]". Own simulated channels; no 3GPP TR 38.811, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "the testing data is generated independently from the training data" (held-out data of the same setting); the input layer size 2(KnN+N)+Kn+N+3 (p. 11) ties each agent to its Kn and N; no agent is tested on a configuration it was not trained for.
q3_support: p. 12: "double deep-Q learning (DQL) technique as proposed in [52]" (learned baseline); p. 12: "the performance of the SAC is comparable to the KKT-based" (non-learned reference), both compared on sum-rate and outage in Figs. 3-6.
q4_support: p. 11: "whereas the SAC scheme converges on-average in 2.01 ms" and "the complexity of the SAC solution is O[I ((2Kn N +" 3N + Kn + 3)W + WX + 2X (Kn N + 2N ))].
q5_support: p. 12: "20,000 independent samples following Monte-Carlo style" simulation; data are self-generated and the paper gives no code or data link (only the CC licence URL on p. 1).
notes: Included as area 6: the learned SAC agent controls transmit power on satellite and aerial links, which is physical layer; single-antenna NTN links are admitted. KKT/SCA scheme is the authors' own non-learned optimization and serves as the non-learned reference for q3. FSO channel follows published models [35]-[38] (log-normal turbulence, Rytov variance, Hufnagel-Valley-type Cn2 profile, pointing error), not a standardized model, so q1 is 0.
